_about: Place filter (library + exercise picker), derived from the equipment filter group of each exercise (data/equipment_mapping.json). `places` = the cards of the Place sheet, in order; each lists the equipment groups that can be used there. Validated by tools/build_catalog.dart (gym must cover every group) and generated into app/lib/features/exercises/data/exercise_filters_data.dart.

_notes.gym: Everything: a gym has all equipment.
_notes.home: Bodyweight (incl. partner-assisted), dumbbells, kettlebells and bands. Balls, rollers, plates-only and machines are not assumed at home.
_notes.bands: Band-type equipment only (dataset `band` + `resistance band`; suspension trainers have no exercises yet).
